{{Quote|Half of success in life is knowing the right people. The other half is knowing all their secrets.|Sullivapat|<ref name="TORE" />}}
'''Sullivapat''' was a data [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Denevar]] who was considered legendary around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the<ref name="TORE" /> [[Galactic War]]<ref name="TORweb">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20130205|text=Game Update 1.7 Developer Blog: Galactic Reputation}}</ref> between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. They believed that success in life was dependent on both knowing the right people and knowing all of their secrets.<ref name="TORE" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sullivapat was mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'', which is a companion guide to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TORE" />
